reason: I have one or two chairs and I cut hair myself, so I already know who is in which chair and I count the drawer every night. Paying ₹4,999 upfront and then ₹999 every month, forever, is about ₹17,000 in the first year for things my notebook and WhatsApp already do for free.
objection: It's another monthly bill that never stops. And if the app hangs on a busy Sunday with customers waiting, who do I call? I can't stop cutting to sit on the phone with support.
would_change_my_mind: No monthly fee: one payment around ₹3,000 that I own, with a local person I can call on Sundays, and proof from another small shop near me that the WhatsApp reminders actually brought customers back.
